description: Publish-stage script that builds a QA web page for a set of NIfTI volumes, writing index.html and copies of the volumes to the session output directory. The page loads NiiVue from esm.sh, so viewing it needs network access; NiiVue's save-html extension is tried first when it imports.

volumes.description: Volumes to render into the QA page (typically the filtered volumes).

title.description: Heading shown on the QA page.

qa_html.description: NiiVue QA web page (index.html), with the volumes copied beside it.

block.label: NiiVue QA Page
block.description: Render a shareable QA page with NiiVue saveHTML.

neuroflow/launch.description: Reads $NEUROFLOW_SESSION/context.json, copies inputs.volumes into $NEUROFLOW_OUTPUT_DIR, and writes index.html there: from the NiiVue save-html extension when it imports, else a page that loads NiiVue from esm.sh.

useWhen: Publish a web page that shows a set of volumes in NiiVue for quality review.
Share results with someone who only has a browser.

avoidWhen.when: A person should review and record corrections interactively.

effects: Writes index.html and copies of the volumes to the output directory.
The page loads NiiVue from esm.sh, so viewing it needs network access.

failures.meaning: The QA page could not be built.
failures.remedy: Read the error that follows in the step log; usually an input volume is missing.
